exposure: women who received both antenatal care and postnatal examinations
cohort: 8815 women in Ghana who had given birth and received both antenatal care and postnatal checks after delivery in health facilities
finding: Over a decade following the initiation of Ghana's free maternal health policy, there remains a significant gap in the awareness of short interpregnancy intervals, even among women who received both antenatal pregnancy care and postnatal examinations before discharge.
mod_finding: Women who delivered via cesarean section had higher awareness of short interpregnancy intervals.
